title: Cucumber Raita
description: Cool, refreshing grated cucumber folded into whisked yogurt with roasted cumin — the simplest cooling side for a spicy thali.
steps: Whisk the curd in a bowl until smooth.
Add the grated cucumber, roasted cumin powder, black salt and green chilli if using.
Garnish with coriander leaves and a light dusting of roasted cumin powder. Chill for 15-20 minutes before serving if time allows.
